newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Adria passenger numbers rise 5 pct Jan-May.
newsitem.headline: Adria passenger numbers rise 5 pct Jan-May.

text.p: Slovenia's only airline Adria Airways said on Wednesday passenger traffic increased five percent in the first five months of this year compared to the same period last year.
The number of passengers rose to 205,700, the company said in a statement. Traffic on scheduled flights was flat while the number of passengers on charter lines jumped 17 percent.
In May alone, the number of passengers on Adria's charter lines soared by 27 percent from May last year.
Adria said its cargo traffic in the first five months rose by three percent to 1,535 tonnes.
